fixed_projection.direction_unit: dimensionless e1 with input-frozen M0 weighted RMS 1
fixed_projection.mass_metric: positive initial dry W dual mass kg per physical cell using adjacent eta pressure thickness and DX*DY/(MAPFAC_MX*MAPFAC_MY)
fixed_projection.projection_direction_source: E307 V2 step-1 accepted Y pressure/Full W RHS; frozen before fine-pair run outputs

interpretation_limits: Pressure and μ-buoyancy work use current accepted-stage dry dual mass; endpoint W projection uses the preregistered frozen M0/e1.
Top W force is independently reconstructed from same-Y p and the source top closure; captured component arrays omit top and are never treated as measured zero.
Step source work is dt times ARK tableau-weighted instantaneous W power, not an exact full-system energy budget or truth-error bound.
Comparing work in joules with e1 projection in m/s is a paired timeline, not a dimensionally equal comparison or proof of cause.
No candidate outputs were used to choose or normalize e1/M0; no extra model/build/RHS call was performed.
scope: offline same-Y pressure/buoyancy work and fixed-e1 endpoint projection; no additional model runs
